description: Semantic attributes used by the local diagnostic engine. tools/build_ontology.py gives a detector label an attribute when the label's WordNet synset is, or descends from (hypernym closure), one of the listed root synsets, or when its COCO supercategory is listed. Roots are WordNet 3.0 synsets; 'gloss' is quoted from WordNet. Nothing here lists detector classes: the classes come from the models' own metadata and are mapped through WordNet.

liquid_container.gloss: vessel.n.03: an object used as a container (especially for liquids)
liquid_container.used_for: spill-risk proximity rule and edge-placement rule

electronic.gloss: electronic_equipment.n.01: equipment that involves the controlled conduction of electrons
electronic.used_for: objects harmed by liquids, food debris or animals nearby

food.gloss: food.n.02: any solid substance (as opposed to liquid) that is used as a source of nourishment

sharp.gloss: edge_tool.n.01: any cutting tool with a sharp cutting edge (as a chisel or knife or plane or gouge)

surface.gloss: table.n.02: a piece of furniture having a smooth flat top that is usually supported by one or more vertical legs
surface.used_for: support surface for edge-placement and surface-occupancy measurements

furniture.gloss: furniture.n.01: furnishings that make a room or other area ready for occupancy
furniture.used_for: large static structures, excluded from clutter counts

appliance.gloss: appliance.n.02: durable goods for home or office use
appliance.used_for: large fixed devices, excluded from clutter counts

animal.gloss: animal.n.01: a living organism characterized by voluntary movement
animal.used_for: animal-near-equipment rule; excluded from clutter counts

person.used_for: people are never identified; only excluded from clutter counts and used for occlusion

cable.gloss: cable.n.02: a conductor for transmitting electrical or optical signals or electric power
cable.used_for: cable-congestion rule (fires only with a detector whose vocabulary includes cables; the bundled COCO models do not)

outlet.gloss: electric_outlet.n.01: receptacle providing a place in a wiring system where current can be taken to run electrical devices
outlet.used_for: liquid-near-outlet hazard (requires a detector with an outlet category)

light_source.gloss: lamp.n.01: an artificial source of visible illumination
light_source.used_for: reserved for lighting diagnostics with detectors that know lamps
